vercel-labs-skills-find-skills.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

vercel-labs-skills-automations-pr-labeli.description: Classify a skills CLI pull request from its description and patch, while respecting existing labels.

vercel-labs-skills-automations-triage-tr.description: Identify focused, evidence-backed skills CLI bug fixes worth quuu's attention.
